loot.n: Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone (Consecrated Snowfield Boss Drop)

markers.note: Ruins in the Mistwood. A Runebear guards a cellar, and Blaidd's howl starts his quest here.
Two Demi-Human Chiefs at the end. If you met Boc, the talking bush, he waits here for his stolen belongings.
The reward for the Homing Instinct painting: a head piece that boosts incantations. Stand where the painting shows, north-west of Seaside Ruins, and a ghost appears with it.
Radahn's castle. During the Radahn Festival this is where the big fight starts.

markers.n: Runebear disguised as a Wandering Noble
markers.note: Kill the lone sword-holding noble east of Agheel Lake South. It turns into a Runebear and drops a Larval Tear.
Boss of the Forlorn Hound Evergaol. Drops the Bloodhound's Fang curved greatsword.
A Golden Seed, Somber Smithing Stones and the Magma Wyrm Makar boss along the cliffs.
The big lift up to the Altus Plateau. Both Dectus Medallion halves make it work.
Light the three braziers to open the barrier and reach its loot, including Night Comet.
Ranni's family manor. Royal Knight Loretta waits at the top, and three areas full of loot open behind it.
A ghostly boatman boss on the east Liurnia shore near the Carian Study Hall.
A giant stone tomb on legs. Hit its feet, climb up, and use a Remembrance to duplicate a boss item.
The Moonveil katana is inside, guarded by a Magma Wyrm.
The Fallingstar Beast boss here drops a Somber Smithing Stone [6] for the Godslayer and a Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing. The Faithful's Canvas Talisman is here too.
The painting in Limgrave's Artist's Shack. It points to the Incantation Scarab near the Dragon-Burnt Ruins.
A Sacred Tear in the church, next to the Ailing Village.
Caria Manor's final boss. Drops Loretta's Greatbow and unlocks Ranni's Rise and the Three Sisters.
A giant root guardian under the Minor Erdtree, plus a Cerulean Crystal Tear.
Boss of the Village of the Albinaurics. There's a Larval Tear in the village graveyard too.
A tower near the Moonlight Altar, in Ranni's quest territory.
A giant flower boss in Tombsward Cave. Drops the Viridian Amber Medallion; a cookbook is elsewhere in the cave.
At night this shack is guarded by a Bell Bearing Hunter who drops a merchant's bell bearing.

markers.n: Grafted Scion disguised as a Giant Crayfish
markers.note: The patrolling crayfish south of Fallen Ruins of the Lake. It drops a Larval Tear.
This one walks around the western Weeping Peninsula.
